name: m7g-background-flush
title: Background offline-queue flush and prefetch
issue: App/ plus Packages/QData: BGTaskScheduler refresh task that flushes the offline queue and prefetches the pinned course version. Register BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers in project.yml. Where web and Android differ, match the Android app's behaviour (cite the relevant Android file in your report; locate it by name). No Swift toolchain locally: push early and fix from CI. Keep each slice under ~600 changed lines; if it grows, stop and report a split.
acceptance: CI green (swift test per package, xcodebuild test)
Concurrency tests: concurrent flush callers share one run; cancellation leaves the queue intact
